bug_report: The upstream is rate-limiting us — our Retrier retries well past where it should stop and crosses the rate-limit window. Restore the intended attempt budget. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.

conversations.text: We're getting rate-limited; the retrier hammers too hard.
I'll lower the attempt budget to a round 5.
Not 5 — it's exactly 7. We measured it: 7 attempts fit just under the upstream's rate-limit window, 8 trips it. Don't round it.
